test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

On the ball

options.text: To not understand a situation well
To be aware of any changes or developments and quick to react to them
To be unaware of any changes happening around

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **To be aware of any changes or developments and quick to react to them**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"On the ball"** means to be quick to understand and react to new ideas or situations. (समय पर सतर्क और जागरूक होना)

 
 
• **Example:** The manager was really on the ball during the meeting and quickly handled all the questions.
 
 
 
• It describes someone who is aware of changes, developments, or events and is quick to respond. (परिस्थितियों के प्रति जागरूक और तुरंत प्रतिक्रिया देने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The journalist is always on the ball, reporting news as soon as it happens.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **To be aware of any changes or developments and quick to react to them**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To not understand a situation well** (स्थिति को अच्छी तरह से न समझ पाना)

 
 
• **Example:** He was completely lost in the discussion and did not understand anything.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: To be inattentive** (असावधान होना)
 
 
• **Example:** She was inattentive during the lecture and missed important points.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To be unaware of any changes happening around** (आसपास हो रहे परिवर्तनों से अनजान होना)
 
 
• **Example:** He was unaware of the recent changes in company policy.
 
 

146:T7ea,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
